sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (William Mitchell State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21 alike): 197 20/30-amp sites $48, 24 50-amp sites $53. The DNR's 2026 table: $45 / $50. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($48 / $53 on 2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21; $45 / $50 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Mitchell campground $50 / $45) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mitchell ('Recreation Passport required'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mitchell (campground tags 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (all 221 sites 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'; 24 with 50 amps), read 2026-10-22

values.note: One modern campground between the Clam Lake Canal and Lake Cadillac, mostly shaded, with select sites along the canal. 20/30-amp sites take trailers/RVs to 40 ft, the 24 50-amp sites to 45 ft. Also a mini cabin and a camper cabin on the Lake Cadillac shore.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mitchell ('Number of sites: 221'; tag 'Pull-through sites available') + midnrreservations.com resources (equipment to 'Trailer or RV up to 40'' / 'up to 45'' on the 50-amp sites), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mitchell (campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Sanitation station', 'Concession or store'; 'There are two sanitation stations located in the campground. There is potable water available') + campground map legend (restroom, vault toilet, water, sanitation station), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mitchell ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + campground map + booking site + DNR rates table: 221 sites, all 20/30 A electric-only and 24 with 50 A, pull-throughs, RVs to 40 ft (45 on the 50-amp sites); showers/flush and vault toilets/two sanitation stations with potable water/store; reservable. Fees 45-50 (2026 table) -> 48-53 (2027 booking site; 2026 rates and the Recreation Passport in fees.note). Season (manual) left as is. Pin sits on the campground's canal-side row (Esri imagery), fine. --AWH note kept unchanged (the DNR page confirms 'select sites along the canal').
flags: Website is only the bare reservation home page and the entry has no phone: the park's own page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/mitchell, phone 231-775-7911. The DNR names it William Mitchell State Park.
